display_name: STAR-RFFI B 与原版 STAR-RFFI 全矩阵配对
description: 复用 B 单种子及全部 57 个原版对照，补齐 56 个同条件 B 训练与评分行。
authorization: 2026-11-27 用户明确指定以 B 组跑原对比实验矩阵并和原版对比。

data.version: 20261023 Main split eq1 locked source and test views
data.representation: FP32 unit-RMS 2x256 IQ; native STAR 2x2048 time/FFT packing with empty second segment
data.physical_ids_ref: Original row source contract and prediction handle
data.split_id: 35 fixed original STAR settings; per-row physical IDs in parent recipes
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 frozen inference via validated test handles; no support
data.leo_config_ref: Reuse original legally generated practical L/U IQ pairs

permissions.external_method_exception: STAR native pseudolabels and clean L-only cross-RX alignment
permissions.claim_scope: Fixed-method paired extension on the established WiSig benchmark

checkpoint.initialization: 56 rows scratch. Main B seed 2026092701 is a display-only exact prior result.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original STAR scores are comparators. Archived B E100 is isolated in source-only smoke.
checkpoint.selection_rule: All B rows fixed E100 EMA with source L BN recalibration. The user selected this fixed recipe after the pilot.

execution.gpu_policy: Up to 4 cards from (2, 6, 7, 5, 3, 1, 0, 4), one worker/card. Train >= 12000 MiB, predict >= 7000 MiB, one CPU scorer.
execution.stop_rule: Fail closed on illegality. Block pending jobs at the same stage after two technical failures, preserve other workers.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent CPU truth-last scorer. Cross-RX raw practical mean is primary; DURA-LU reported separately.

notes: B recipe fixed unchanged from the completed pilot: supervised cross-RX clean identity weight 0.20, temperature 0.15, late labeled CE floor 0.30.
33 paper rows and 24 supplements. Reuse F0 seed 2026092701 B; train other 56 from scratch against 57 complete native STAR baselines.
Paper includes Main, receiver reassignments, 1%/5% labels, 10 classes and natural RX counts. Five-source point is derived from the matched common-target Main records.
